title: Synthesis of a triphenylamine-based "ON-OFF" type fluorescent probe: Cu(2+) detection, DNA binding studies and theoretical calculations.
authors: Pang, Yanling; Liu, Jian; Ji, Jie; Pang, Sen; Zhang, Weilu; Han, Dandan; Meng, Desu; Liu, Qinghua; Duan, Shengxia
journal: Spectrochimica acta. Part A, Molecular and biomolecular spectroscopy
one_liner_zh: 该文合成三苯胺基Cu2+荧光探针并研究其与DNA的沟槽结合，含分子对接与DFT计算，但核心是金属离子检测而非TF-DNA互作，方法可迁移性有限。
abstract: A Cu(2+) fluorescent probe molecule (S) of the "ON-OFF" type was designed and synthesized using 4-(diphenylamino)benzaldehyde and carbohydrazide as starting materials. The structure of S was systematically characterized using IR spectroscopy, HRMS, (1)H NMR, and (13)C NMR. Spectroscopic experiments demonstrated that the binding stoichiometry of S to Cu(2+) was 1:1, with remarkable selectivity and sensitivity for detecting Cu(2+). Moreover, the detection limit of 3.5 x 10(-8) mol⋅L(-1) was significantly lower than those reported for previously developed fluorescent sensors targeting Cu(2+). Density functional theory (DFT) and time-dependent DFT (TD-DFT) calculations revealed that Cu(2+) ions coordinated with the imine nitrogen and carbonyl oxygen of the Schiff base, triggering a photoinduced electron transfer (PET) effect that quenched the fluorescence of Schiff base S. Furthermore, the interaction between S and zebrafish sperm DNA (zf-DNA) was investigated using a combination of spectroscopic methods, DNA binding assays (with both single- and double-stranded DNA), viscosity measurements, and molecular docking simulations. The findings revealed that the primary mode of interaction between S and zf-DNA was groove-face binding, which occurred spontaneously and was governed by hydrogen bonds, CH interactions, pi-pi stacking, and van der Waals forces. In summary, the developed Schiff-base probe S demonstrates high sensitivity and selectivity for Cu(2+) detection in complex environmental matrices. Moreover, this study advances the understanding of Schiff-base-DNA interactions and introduces a novel strategy for designing multifunctional sensors applicable to biomacromolecule detection and anticancer drug development.
abstract_zh: 以4-(二苯氨基)苯甲醛和卡巴肼为起始原料，设计并合成了一种“开-关”型Cu(2+)荧光探针分子(S)。通过红外光谱、高分辨质谱、(1)H NMR和(13)C NMR对S的结构进行了系统表征。光谱实验表明，S与Cu(2+)的结合化学计量比为1:1，对Cu(2+)的检测具有显著的选择性和灵敏度。此外，检测限为3.5 x 10(-8) mol⋅L(-1)，显著低于先前报道的针对Cu(2+)的荧光传感器。密度泛函理论(DFT)和时间依赖密度泛函理论(TD-DFT)计算揭示，Cu(2+)离子与席夫碱的亚胺氮和羰基氧配位，触发光诱导电子转移(PET)效应，从而猝灭席夫碱S的荧光。进一步地，通过光谱方法、DNA结合实验（包括单链和双链DNA）、粘度测量和分子对接模拟相结合，研究了S与斑马鱼精子DNA (zf-DNA)之间的相互作用。结果表明，S与zf-DNA的主要相互作用模式为沟面结合，该过程自发进行，并由氢键、CH相互作用、π-π堆积和范德华力主导。总之，所开发的席夫碱探针S在复杂环境基质中对Cu(2+)检测表现出高灵敏度和高选择性。此外，本研究增进了对席夫碱-DNA相互作用的理解，并为设计适用于生物大分子检测和抗癌药物开发的多功能传感器引入了一种新策略。
